headline: UK Imposes New Investment Requirements on Foreign Defense Contractors
summary: Wes Streeting announced that foreign firms awarded large UK defense contracts will be required to invest an equal value back into the UK economy.
why: Defense procurement policy shifts alter operating conditions and local investment obligations for international contractors bidding on government projects.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: New rules mandate foreign defense contractors to invest back into the UK.
